notice: Aggregator key universes fully re-captured 2026-10-07 from models.dev/api.json and github.com/BerriAI/litellm main (model_prices_and_context_window.json, the same ref the live source reads). Keys only, no values: this fixture exists so the join-coverage guard and the dead-alias check run without egress. modelsDev holds the model ids of only the providers listed in modelsDevProviders (MODELS_DEV_PROVIDER_BY_BACKEND), unioned into one flat list. litellm holds the bare keys plus every key under a first-party namespace the join collapses (LITELLM_NAMESPACES in b4m-core/common/src/modelIdJoin.ts: anthropic, openai, gemini, xai, bedrock, ollama, elevenlabs, voyage, black_forest_labs, moonshot, deepseek), because a key whose gateway prefix survives normalization can never match one of our ids and must never be aliased to. Both sides carry keys for ids this build does not ship, the same as every other provider here - the capture is the provider's whole key space, not our catalog. To refresh, re-apply those two rules to a fresh fetch and rerun modelIdAliases.test.ts: a retired key that an alias names fails the dead-alias check, and the join rates are measured in that test's header comment. litellm main has no kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed and no first-party grok-3-fast, so neither joins there.
